definitions.gloss: dumbfounded, stunned, in a daze, stupefied
definitions.explanation: A state of being so shocked, surprised, or overwhelmed that one cannot think or react. Often describes standing or sitting motionless in disbelief.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{呆然|ぼうぜん}と{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くした。
{突然|とつぜん}の{知|し}らせに{呆然|ぼうぜん}とした。
examples.english: I was stunned by the sudden news.

examples.japanese: {火事|かじ}で{家|いえ}を{失|うしな}った{人|ひと}たちが、{焼|や}け{跡|あと}の{前|まえ}で{呆然|ぼうぜん}と{立|た}っていた。
examples.english: The people who had lost their homes in the fire stood dazed in front of the burned remains.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Taru-adjective. Used adverbially as {呆然|ぼうぜん}と (in a daze) or attributively as {呆然|ぼうぜん}たる (dazed). The adverbial form {呆然|ぼうぜん}と is far more common.

USAGE:
Almost always paired with physical descriptions of immobility: {立|た}ち{尽|つ}くす (to stand rooted), {座|すわ}り{込|こ}む (to collapse into sitting), {見|み}つめる (to stare).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {茫然|ぼうぜん}: same pronunciation and very similar meaning; the two are often interchangeable. {茫然|ぼうぜん} may emphasize a more blank, vacant feeling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呆然|ぼうぜん}と{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くす: to stand rooted in shock
- {呆然|ぼうぜん}とする: to be dumbfounded
- {呆然自失|ぼうぜんじしつ}: stupefied, in a state of shock
